description: 35 parallel agents to find, evaluate, and rank the best APIs and platforms for grey market intelligence, monitoring, and detection

phases.name: Market Landscape Discovery

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL brand protection and anti-counterfeiting API providers. For EACH provider list: company name, API product name, website URL, what data they provide, pricing model (free tier? per-call? subscription?), key features, notable clients.

Specifically research: Red Points, MarqVision, BrandShield, Corsearch, Pointer Brand Protection, Incopro, Yellow Brand Protection, BrandMonitor, Huboo, TrackStreet, MUSO, OpSec Security, MarkMonitor (Clarivate), CSC Digital Brand Services.

Also search for: 'brand protection API', 'anti-counterfeiting API', 'grey market detection API', 'unauthorized reseller API', 'MAP monitoring API', 'minimum advertised price API'. List every provider found with their API capabilities.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a market research analyst specializing in brand protection technology. Provide comprehensive, factual information about each provider. Include pricing where publicly available. Note which providers have public APIs vs enterprise-only access.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL price monitoring and competitive intelligence API providers that can track pricing across marketplaces, detect arbitrage, and monitor grey market pricing.

Specifically research: Prisync, Competera, Intelligence Node, Price2Spy, Minderest, Dealavo, Sniffie, Omnia Retail, Informed (formerly Feedvisor), BlackCurve, Profitero, DataWeave, Skuuudle, NetRivals (Lengow), Pricefx, PriceGrid.

For EACH provider list: company name, API availability (REST/GraphQL/webhooks), data coverage (which marketplaces/regions), pricing tiers, real-time vs batch, accuracy claims, notable clients, free trial availability.

Also search for: 'price intelligence API', 'competitive pricing API', 'marketplace price tracking API', 'dynamic pricing API', 'price comparison API'.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a market research analyst. Provide factual, detailed information about each provider's API capabilities. Focus on technical specifications and pricing. Note which have self-serve APIs vs enterprise-only.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL threat intelligence and dark web monitoring API providers relevant to grey market intelligence.

Specifically research: Recorded Future, Flashpoint, Intel 471, DarkOwl, Cybersixgill, SOCRadar, Flare (formerly Flare Systems), ZeroFox, Digital Shadows (now ReliaQuest), Group-IB, KELA, Constella Intelligence, SpyCloud, Hudson Rock, Webz.io (formerly Webhose), Have I Been Pwned API.

For EACH list: API name, endpoint types, data sources (dark web forums, paste sites, Telegram, marketplaces), pricing model, free tier, rate limits, data formats (JSON/CSV), authentication method, notable capabilities for grey market monitoring.

Also search for: 'dark web API', 'threat intelligence API', 'underground market API', 'leaked credentials API', 'stolen account monitoring API'.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a cybersecurity analyst. Provide detailed technical information about each threat intelligence API. Focus on capabilities relevant to monitoring grey markets, unauthorized reselling, and underground commerce.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL marketplace monitoring and e-commerce intelligence API providers.

Specifically research: Jungle Scout API, Helium 10 API, Keepa API, CamelCamelCamel, Sellics/Perpetua, AMZScout, Marketplace Pulse, Algopix, SellerApp, DataHawk, SmartScout, SimilarWeb API, Semrush Marketplace data, Marketplace API direct access (Amazon SP-API, eBay Browse API, Walmart Marketplace API, AliExpress API, Taobao/Tmall API access).

For EACH list: API availability, data provided (prices, sellers, reviews, inventory), rate limits, pricing, authentication, coverage (which marketplaces/countries), historical data depth, real-time capabilities.

Special focus on: APIs that can monitor Xianyu (闲鱼), Taobao (淘宝), Pinduoduo, and other Chinese marketplaces where grey market activity is concentrated.
tasks.system_prompt: You are an e-commerce intelligence analyst. Provide detailed API specifications for each marketplace monitoring tool. Note which have direct marketplace API access vs scraping-based data.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL web scraping, data extraction, and web intelligence API providers relevant to grey market monitoring.

Specifically research: Bright Data (formerly Luminati), Oxylabs, Apify, ScrapingBee, ScraperAPI, Diffbot, Import.io, Zyte (formerly Scrapinghub/Crawlera), ParseHub, WebScraper.io, ScrapeOps, Crawlbase, PhantomBuster, ProxyCrawl, DataForSEO.

For EACH list: API type (proxy/scraping/structured data), pricing per request or per GB, free tier, residential vs datacenter proxies, success rates, supported sites, anti-bot bypass capabilities, structured data extraction, JavaScript rendering.

Also research SERP APIs: SerpApi, ValueSERP, Serper.dev, DataForSEO SERP — which can monitor grey market listings in search results.

Special focus on: Which can reliably scrape Chinese marketplaces (Xianyu, Taobao, Pinduoduo, WeChat Mini Programs)?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a web data specialist. Provide detailed technical and pricing information for each web scraping/data API. Focus on capabilities relevant to monitoring grey market activity across global and Chinese marketplaces.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL social media monitoring, forum tracking, and messaging platform intelligence APIs relevant to grey market detection.

Specifically research: Brandwatch API, Meltwater API, Talkwalker API, Sprout Social API, Brand24 API, Mention API, Awario, BuzzSumo API, Telegram Bot API + channel monitoring tools, Discord API + server monitoring, Reddit API (pushshift replacement), Twitter/X API, Telemetr.io, TGStat, Social Searcher API.

For EACH list: API capabilities, pricing, rate limits, coverage (which platforms), sentiment analysis, keyword monitoring, alert capabilities.

Special focus on:
1. Telegram channel/group monitoring APIs (where proxy operators advertise)
2. Discord server monitoring (where proxy communities exist)
3. Reddit monitoring for r/ChatGPT, r/LocalLLaMA grey market discussions
4. Chinese social media monitoring (Weibo, WeChat, Xiaohongshu/RED)
5. Real-time alert capabilities for new grey market listings
tasks.system_prompt: You are a social media intelligence analyst. Provide detailed API specifications focused on capabilities for monitoring underground/grey market commerce on social platforms and messaging apps.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL cryptocurrency and payment tracking API providers relevant to grey market financial intelligence.

Specifically research: Chainalysis API (KYT, Reactor), Elliptic API, TRM Labs, Crystal Blockchain, CipherTrace (Mastercard), Merkle Science, Scorechain, Coinfirm, Blockseer, AnChain.AI, Nansen API, Dune Analytics API, Etherscan API, Blockchain.com API.

Also research payment fraud detection APIs: Stripe Radar API, Sift Science API, Riskified API, Forter API, Kount API, SEON API, Sardine API.

For EACH list: API capabilities, pricing, free tier, data coverage (which chains/payment methods), transaction tracing depth, risk scoring, compliance features.

Special focus on: APIs that can trace USDT/Tether payments (primary grey market currency), Alipay transaction patterns, virtual prepaid card detection.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a financial intelligence analyst. Provide detailed information about payment and cryptocurrency tracking APIs. Focus on capabilities relevant to monitoring grey market financial flows.

phases.synthesis_prompt: Synthesize findings from 7 agents who researched the complete landscape of grey market intelligence APIs across: brand protection, price monitoring, threat intelligence, marketplace monitoring, web scraping, social media monitoring, and crypto/payment tracking. Create a MASTER PROVIDER LIST organized by category with: Provider Name | Category | API Type | Pricing | Free Tier | Key Capability | Best For. Identify the TOP 5 most relevant APIs for AI API grey market intelligence specifically. Note which categories have the most mature API ecosystems vs which are underserved.

phases.name: Technical Deep Evaluation

tasks.prompt:
Evaluate the API documentation quality and developer experience for the TOP providers identified in grey market intelligence.

For each of these providers, research their API docs: Recorded Future, Flashpoint, DarkOwl, Bright Data, Diffbot, Keepa, Jungle Scout, Red Points, Prisync, Webz.io, Chainalysis, SEON, Brandwatch, SerpApi, Apify.

For EACH evaluate:
1. Documentation quality (1-10): Interactive docs? OpenAPI spec? Code examples?
2. SDK availability: Python, Node.js, Go, Java?
3. Authentication: API key, OAuth2, JWT?
4. Sandbox/test environment available?
5. Quickstart time (minutes to first API call)
6. Community: GitHub stars, Stack Overflow questions, Discord/Slack
7. Rate limit transparency
8. Error handling quality
9. Changelog/versioning
10. Overall developer experience (DX) score 1-10
tasks.system_prompt: You are a developer experience analyst. Evaluate API documentation and DX from a developer's perspective. Be specific about what's good and bad. Provide actual URLs to documentation pages where possible.

tasks.prompt:
Create a comprehensive pricing comparison for ALL grey market intelligence APIs.

For each provider, research EXACT pricing:
1. Free tier: What's included? Requests/month? Data limits?
2. Starter/developer tier: Price, limits
3. Professional tier: Price, limits
4. Enterprise tier: Price range (if known)
5. Pay-per-call pricing
6. Annual vs monthly discount
7. Overage charges
8. Hidden costs (setup fees, minimum commitments, data storage)

Organize by budget level:
- $0/mo (free only): What can you get?
- $50-100/mo: Best options?
- $100-500/mo: Best options?
- $500-2,000/mo: Best options?
- $2,000-10,000/mo: Best options?
- $10,000+/mo: Enterprise options?

Specifically price out: building a grey market monitoring dashboard that tracks AI API proxy pricing across Telegram, Xianyu, GitHub, and Discord. What would it cost using different API combinations?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a procurement analyst. Research EXACT pricing from official pricing pages. If pricing is not public, note 'Contact sales' and estimate based on industry benchmarks. Be precise about what each tier includes.

tasks.prompt:
Evaluate data coverage and accuracy for grey market intelligence APIs.

For the TOP 15 providers, research:
1. Geographic coverage: Which countries/regions?
2. Marketplace coverage: Which platforms monitored?
3. Language support: English only? Chinese? Russian? Arabic?
4. Data freshness: Real-time? Hourly? Daily? Weekly?
5. Historical data: How far back?
6. Data accuracy claims and independent verification
7. Data completeness (what's missing?)
8. Source diversity (how many data sources?)

CRITICAL for AI grey market use case:
- Can it monitor Chinese platforms (Xianyu, Taobao, Pinduoduo)?
- Can it monitor Telegram groups/channels?
- Can it monitor Discord servers?
- Can it track USDT/crypto payments?
- Can it monitor GitHub for proxy tools?
- Can it detect AI API proxy advertisements?
- Can it track pricing changes in real-time?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a data quality analyst. Evaluate each provider's data coverage specifically for monitoring AI API grey market activity. Be honest about gaps — many providers won't cover Chinese platforms or Telegram.

tasks.prompt:
Evaluate integration complexity for grey market intelligence APIs.

For the TOP 15 providers, research:
1. Time to first value: How long from signup to useful data?
2. Integration methods: REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, webhooks, SDK?
3. Data export formats: JSON, CSV, XML, Parquet?
4. Webhook/streaming support for real-time alerts?
5. Pre-built integrations: Slack, email, SIEM, Jira, Zapier?
6. Custom dashboard/UI included?
7. Bulk data export capability?
8. ETL/data pipeline compatibility (Snowflake, BigQuery, S3)?
9. Multi-tenancy support (for reselling/white-label)?
10. API versioning and backward compatibility?

Also evaluate: Can these APIs be combined? What's the best STACK of 2-3 APIs that together cover the full grey market intelligence use case (monitoring + detection + alerting)?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a solutions architect. Evaluate APIs from an integration perspective. Focus on practical considerations: what works well together, what's hard to integrate, what's the fastest path to a working system.

tasks.prompt:
Evaluate reliability, SLAs, and uptime for grey market intelligence APIs.

For the TOP 15 providers, research:
1. Published SLA (uptime guarantee)
2. Status page URL and historical uptime
3. Rate limits (requests/second, requests/day)
4. Burst handling
5. Latency (P50, P95, P99 response times)
6. Error rates
7. Support response times (by tier)
8. Data delivery guarantees
9. Incident history (major outages in last 12 months)
10. Security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR compliance)

Also research: Which providers have had data breaches, security incidents, or significant reliability issues? Which have the best track record?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a reliability engineer. Evaluate each API's operational excellence. Check status pages, review sites (G2, Capterra), and incident history. Be specific about SLAs and uptime data.

tasks.prompt:
Research APIs specifically designed for AI model/API monitoring, AI security, and AI usage detection.

Specifically research:
1. AI security platforms: Robust Intelligence, HiddenLayer, Protect AI, CalypsoAI, Lakera, Rebuff
2. AI observability: LangSmith, Helicone, Langfuse, PromptLayer, Weights & Biases, Arize AI
3. AI gateway/proxy management: LiteLLM, Portkey, Martian, Unify AI, AI Gateway (Cloudflare)
4. AI cost management: OpenMeter, TokenCost, LLMeter
5. AI compliance/governance: Credo AI, Holistic AI, Fairly AI
6. Model fingerprinting/watermarking: AI model identification APIs

For EACH: API capabilities, pricing, free tier, how it could be used for grey market AI API detection.

KEY QUESTION: Is there ANY API that specifically detects unauthorized AI API proxy usage? Can any combination of existing APIs be used to build such a system?
tasks.system_prompt: You are an AI security specialist. Research all APIs in the AI security, observability, and governance space. Focus on which could be repurposed or combined for grey market AI API detection.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL open-source tools and free APIs that can be used for grey market intelligence.

Specifically research:
1. OSINT frameworks: SpiderFoot, Maltego CE, theHarvester, Recon-ng, Shodan (free tier), Censys (free tier)
2. Web scraping: Scrapy, Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, crawlee (Apify OSS)
3. Telegram monitoring: Telethon, Pyrogram, TelegramMonitorBot
4. Discord monitoring: discord.py, Discord webhooks
5. Reddit monitoring: PRAW, Pushshift alternatives
6. Price tracking: camelcamelcamel (free), Keepa (free tier), Google Shopping scraping
7. Dark web: Tor + custom crawlers, Ahmia search API
8. GitHub monitoring: GitHub API (free tier), GitHub Actions for tracking repos
9. Social listening: GDELT Project API (free), NewsAPI (free tier)
10. Data analysis: pandas, DuckDB, Metabase (free), Grafana (free)

For EACH: capabilities, limitations, setup complexity, maintenance burden, and how to use it for AI grey market monitoring.

Design a COMPLETE free/OSS stack for monitoring the AI API grey market.
tasks.system_prompt: You are an OSINT specialist. Research free and open-source tools for intelligence gathering. Be practical — focus on what actually works for grey market monitoring. Include setup complexity estimates.

phases.synthesis_prompt: Synthesize technical evaluations from 7 agents covering: API documentation, pricing, data coverage, integration, reliability, AI-specific tools, and open-source alternatives. Create: 1) A RANKED comparison table of TOP 20 APIs with scores for DX, Pricing, Coverage, Reliability, and AI-Grey-Market Fit. 2) PRICING TIERS showing best options at each budget level. 3) RECOMMENDED STACKS (combinations of 2-3 APIs) for different use cases. 4) A complete FREE/OSS stack design. 5) Identify the single biggest GAP in the market — what API doesn't exist but should?

phases.name: Solution Architecture

tasks.prompt:
Design a COMPLETE free/open-source grey market intelligence stack.

Requirements:
- $0/month budget
- Monitor AI API proxy activity across: Telegram, Discord, GitHub, Reddit, Chinese marketplaces
- Detect new proxy services, track pricing, alert on changes
- Dashboard for visualization
- Automated data collection

Design the stack:
1. Data Collection: Which free tools/APIs? (Telegram Bot API, GitHub API, Reddit API, Discord webhooks, etc.)
2. Data Storage: SQLite? PostgreSQL? DuckDB?
3. Data Processing: Python scripts? Cron jobs? GitHub Actions?
4. Analysis: pandas? SQL queries? Simple ML?
5. Visualization: Grafana? Metabase? Custom HTML dashboard?
6. Alerting: Email? Slack webhook? Telegram bot?

Provide EXACT setup steps, estimated setup time, and maintenance burden. What's the daily operational cost (compute, storage)?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a solutions architect. Design a practical, buildable system using only free tools. Be specific about implementation details — this should be a blueprint someone can follow.

tasks.prompt:
Design an OPTIMAL grey market intelligence stack for a startup budget ($200-500/month).

Requirements:
- Comprehensive coverage of AI API grey market
- Real-time alerting on new proxy services and price changes
- Historical data for trend analysis
- Dashboard for stakeholders
- Minimal maintenance burden

Design the stack selecting from APIs researched in prior phases:
1. Core monitoring API (pick 1-2): [justify selection]
2. Web scraping/data (pick 1): [justify selection]
3. Social/messaging monitoring (pick 1): [justify selection]
4. Alerting and workflow: [justify selection]
5. Storage and analytics: [justify selection]

Provide:
- Total monthly cost breakdown
- What you get vs what you miss at this budget
- Setup time estimate
- Ongoing maintenance hours/week
- Scaling path to enterprise
tasks.system_prompt: You are a startup CTO. Design the most cost-effective grey market intelligence system. Optimize for value per dollar. Be specific about which API tiers to choose.

tasks.prompt:

- Compliance-ready reporting (SOC 2, ISO 27001)

- Multi-user dashboard
- ML-powered anomaly detection

Design the platform selecting BEST-IN-CLASS components:
1. Threat intelligence: [selection + justification]
2. Web data platform: [selection + justification]
3. Marketplace monitoring: [selection + justification]
4. Social/messaging intelligence: [selection + justification]
5. Payment/crypto intelligence: [selection + justification]
6. AI-specific monitoring: [selection + justification]
7. Analytics/ML platform: [selection + justification]
8. Dashboard/reporting: [selection + justification]

Provide total cost breakdown and ROI justification.
tasks.system_prompt: You are an enterprise solutions architect. Design the ultimate grey market intelligence platform. Justify every component selection. Include compliance and security considerations.

tasks.prompt:
ANALYSIS: Build vs Buy for grey market intelligence.

Compare three approaches:

APPROACH A: Buy existing platform (single vendor)
- Which vendors offer the most complete grey market intelligence platform?
- Total cost of ownership (license + integration + maintenance)
- Time to value
- Pros/cons

APPROACH B: Assemble from APIs (best-of-breed)
- Pick 3-5 best APIs and integrate them
- Total cost: API fees + development + maintenance
- Time to value
- Pros/cons

APPROACH C: Build custom (open-source + custom code)
- Use free tools + custom scraping/monitoring code
- Total cost: development + hosting + maintenance
- Time to value
- Pros/cons

For EACH approach, estimate:
1. Setup cost (one-time)
2. Monthly operating cost
3. Time to first useful intelligence
4. Coverage completeness (% of grey market activity captured)
5. Maintenance burden (hours/week)
6. Scalability
7. Risk of platform lock-in

Recommend: Which approach for which audience? (Solo researcher, startup, enterprise, government agency)
tasks.system_prompt: You are a technology strategy consultant. Provide an honest build-vs-buy analysis. Include total cost of ownership for each approach over a 2-year period.
